name: Umihara Tsubura
source:
First-year student. "Go Home Club" member. Kouhai of the protagonist and close friend of Mashiro.

Along with Mashiro, she's one of the three girls who has been the target of the protagonist's naughty mischiefs. She's quiet and not very assertive. She's shy and always stays close to Mashiro at school. Hates drawing attention to herself.

Feels uncomfortable around guys other than the protagonist and has trouble talking to them. She's being sexually harrassed by the protagonist even today and is enjoying it.

Studies fighting games and enjoys listening to the damage voices of female characters. She's skilled at losing.

[Translated from the [url=https://edoire.jp/products/ikunew/chr/03.html]official website[/url]]

Bust Size: 89cm F-cup -> 101cm J-cup
